title: PA231 learned neural line coordinate
hypothesis: A PA231-trained low-loss line yields several accurate, measurably diverse neural classifiers from two endpoints and small alpha codes, using fewer serialized bytes than materializing every line model; Mirror coordinate m=2alpha-1 must match native interpolation exactly.
physical_object: Two learned MLP endpoint weight tensors
mirror_coordinate: Scalar coordinate m=2alpha-1 along the learned endpoint line
logical_multiplicity: Accurate neural models sampled along one low-loss line
controls: same line decoded with Mirror m
17 materialized line models exact-output storage control
independent models compute-matched and fully trained

development.selection_metric: development NLL; useful-line gate uses worst-grid accuracy within 2 percentage points of standard model and endpoint disagreement >0.5%

selected_settings.selection_basis: minimum mean validation NLL across the 17-point alpha grid; development seed 31

default_comparator.description: PA231 paper default, reported as a fixed comparator, not selected

success_gate: Fresh selected beta=0.1 line has worst-grid accuracy no more than 2 percentage points below its paired standard MLP, endpoint disagreement above 0.5%, and endpoint+coordinate actual serialized bytes below 17 materialized line models. The beta=1 PA231 default is reported separately. Mirror-specific gain additionally requires a result beyond ordinary alpha interpolation.
failure_gate: Selected line misses quality/diversity gate, or Mirror coordinate exactly aliases ordinary interpolation; report line utility separately from Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: Dataset is sklearn Digits, scaled by 1/16, stratified 60/20/20 split. Fresh seeds are training initialization/data-order replicates on the same heldout test partition, not unseen-task generalization.
Model is MLP 64→32→10 with ReLU, no BatchNorm/dropout (~2,410 parameters).
PA231 Algorithm 1: independently initialize endpoints, sample alpha~Uniform[0,1] each minibatch, optimize CE + beta*cos^2(endpoint weights) with SGD momentum .9; beta=1 default and beta=0 ablation.
Fresh runs are not used to tune. No language-model or new-capacity claim follows from line sample count.

amendments.reason: Replace exploratory XOR proposal with PA231 line training on Digits before any fresh evaluation; development selects beta=0.1 while beta=1 remains a fixed paper-default comparator.
Fresh screen completed under the frozen settings; selected-line worst-grid accuracy exceeded the 2 pp allowance on seed 61, and ordinary alpha versus Mirror m gives exact logits.
